worst_flaw: The design relies on existing safety spot checks to judge quality but never sets audit coverage, a review owner or a trigger threshold, so rushed checklists ticked just to hit the 80% reward goal could go undetected. It also has no replayable event history, no independent shadow validation of counts before payout, no fixed appeal deadline, no power or sample-size analysis for the paired-crew comparison, and no cost or harm decision criteria.
